beach.phrase: On the sandy knolls of the beach
beach.description: The sand feels good between your toes, a vast and endless ocean in front of you

desert.phrase: Under the scorching sun of the desert
desert.description: The sun beats down on your back as you traverse sand dunes

forest.phrase: Through thick foliage and towering trees
forest.description: The trees are green and critters run between their roots

jungle.phrase: Within the dense and humid jungle
jungle.description: Vines tug at your ankles as you hack your way through the thick foliage

mountains.phrase: Amidst the towering peaks of the mountains
mountains.description: The path is steep and treacherous, the great peaks high above you still

ocean.description: The waves crash against the shore as furtive fish dart beneath the surface
